q: Bernoulli's equation applies to a _____ flow.
e: Bernoulli's equation applies to a laminar flow. Laminar flow moves in smooth layers with no mixing between neighbouring sheets. turbulent or rotational is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The air flow moving above the top curved surface of an aeroplane wing has a _____ distance to travel.
e: The air flow moving above the top curved surface of an aeroplane wing has a longer distance to travel. shorter or equal is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The velocity of air flow is _____ along the top surface of an aeroplane wing.
e: The velocity of air flow is high along the top surface of an aeroplane wing. low or zero is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The high velocity of air flow along the top surface of a wing causes a _____ pressure above the wing.
e: The high velocity of air flow along the top surface of a wing causes a low pressure above the wing. Bernoulli: high speed goes with low pressure. high or constant is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The lift on the wings of an aeroplane is provided by a pressure difference where pressure is high _____ the wing.
e: The lift on the wings of an aeroplane is provided by a pressure difference where pressure is high below the wing. above or inside is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: In an insect sprayer, the fast moving air causes a _____ pressure at the tip of the nozzle.
e: In an insect sprayer, the fast moving air causes a low pressure at the tip of the nozzle. Bernoulli: high speed goes with low pressure. high or atmospheric is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: In an insect sprayer, the liquid rushes up through the stem because the liquid inside the container is at a _____ pressure.
e: In an insect sprayer, the liquid rushes up through the stem because the liquid inside the container is at a higher pressure. The still fluid sits at higher pressure than the fast stream. lower or zero is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The Magnus effect is commonly associated with a _____ object moving through a fluid.
e: The Magnus effect is commonly associated with a spinning object moving through a fluid. stationary or linear is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The Magnus effect produces the _____ of a spinning ball.
e: The Magnus effect produces the deflection of a spinning ball. expansion or compression is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The Magnus effect was described in 1852 by the German physicist _____.
e: The Magnus effect was described in 1852 by the German physicist Heinrich Gustav Magnus. Daniel Bernoulli or George Stokes is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: During cyclones, moving air gains speed above the roof of a house causing _____ pressure on the roof.
e: During cyclones, moving air gains speed above the roof of a house causing reduced pressure on the roof. increased or atmospheric is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: During cyclones, the roof of a house can fly away because the pressure inside the house is _____ than the pressure on the roof.
e: During cyclones, the roof of a house can fly away because the pressure inside the house is greater than the pressure on the roof. less or equal is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: In the Magnus effect, where the velocity of air and velocity of the ball are in opposite directions, it _____ the velocity of air flow.
e: In the Magnus effect, where the velocity of air and velocity of the ball are in opposite directions, it reduces the velocity of air flow. increases or doubles is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: In the Magnus effect, a reduction in the velocity of air flow results in _____ pressure.
e: In the Magnus effect, a reduction in the velocity of air flow results in high pressure. low or zero is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: In the Magnus effect, where the velocity of air and velocity of the ball are in the same direction, it increases the velocity of air flow which leads to _____ pressure.
e: In the Magnus effect, where the velocity of air and velocity of the ball are in the same direction, it increases the velocity of air flow which leads to low pressure. Bernoulli: high speed goes with low pressure. high or atmospheric is a different idea, so those options are wrong.
